summary: Cebu 4th District representative with about 43 principal-authored bills. Rubric-relevant record is tax relief in disaster-stricken areas, travel-tax abolition, fuel tax relief (co-author) and anti-dynasty bills. No dimension reaches two adequately evidenced issues.
caveat: Taxation counts as one issue and anti-dynasty as one issue, so no dimension is scored. Extractor may under-report.
